criteria.description: Does the application meet the stated requirements and function correctly?
Are React/component patterns, hooks, and state management used correctly?
Is the code well-organized, readable, and maintainable?
Are inputs sanitized, auth handled safely, and no sensitive data exposed?
Is the interface intuitive, responsive, and visually consistent?
Is there a clear README with setup, usage, and architecture notes?
Are there unit/integration tests covering key functionality?
Does the API/application meet all stated requirements?
Are framework patterns, routing, and middleware used correctly?
Is the code modular, typed, and well-structured?
Are auth, input validation, and data protection handled properly?
Are errors caught, logged, and returned as safe messages?
Is there a clear README with API docs and setup instructions?
Are there tests for endpoints and business logic?
Does the full application (frontend + backend) meet all requirements?
Are both frontend and backend patterns used correctly and integrated?
Is the codebase well-organized across frontend and backend?
Is auth consistent across stack? Are APIs protected and inputs validated?
Is the user interface functional and responsive?
Is there a comprehensive README covering both frontend and backend?
Are there tests for both frontend and backend?
Does the analysis answer the stated business questions?
Are pandas/numpy/statistical methods used correctly?
Is the notebook/script well-organized and reproducible?
Is data cleaning thorough with documented steps?
Are statistical methods appropriate and conclusions well-supported?
Are visualizations clear, labeled, and appropriate for the data?
Is there a README with findings and methodology?
Does the model achieve reasonable performance for the stated problem?
Are ML libraries (scikit-learn, etc.) used correctly?
Is the pipeline modular and the code reproducible?
Is train/test split proper? Are metrics appropriate? No data leakage?
Is preprocessing thorough with feature engineering documented?
Are model results and feature importance visualized clearly?
Is there a README with methodology and results interpretation?
